Looking forward to the demo tomorrow. I noticed the invite is for 10:00 AM PT / 18:00 CET. Two quick things before we lock:

Europe's "spring forward" DST change is tonight (clocks move forward 1 hour). That skews the conversions from what everyone originally agreed. To avoid a poor experience for any party, would BrightRetail be open to shifting the demo by 1 hour earlier or moving to a mid-day CET slot (so it stays reasonable for PT and JST)?

Two quick options we can offer:
1) Move to 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST (earlier for Hiro, still late)
2) Move to 12:00 PT / 20:00 CET / 04:00 JST (later for PT but better for Hiro)

I've attached a short agenda and a .ics with both proposed slots. If neither works, tell us a hard blackout window and we'll propose alternatives.

Thanks —
